ancrel.4065.zh: 考古学家失踪（第一阶段后）

notes.zh: 开场：需要《远古遗物》。非AI帝国在星球上清除丛林、毒藻、沼泽或冰川类障碍时（on_blocker_cleared），隐藏的 ancrel.4030 以 5/5/95 在神谕与哨兵之间抽取；哨兵还要求非母星、非格式塔、人口>500，全银河一次。1天后出现此事件，可建立遗址或不予理会。
notes.en: Opening: needs Ancient Relics. When a non-AI empire clears a jungle, kelp, swamp or glacier blocker (on_blocker_cleared), hidden ancrel.4030 draws Oracle / Sentinels / nothing at 5/5/95; the Sentinels also need a non-homeworld, non-gestalt planet with more than 500 pops, once per galaxy. This event follows a day later; the site may be created or ignored.

notes.zh: 四个选择：调查（非排外）或拆解都启动项目并最终到 4058；摧毁（非亲外）启动项目到 4055；放任（非排外）则保留雕像，星球获得哨兵修正与矿藏，故事到此结束。
notes.en: Four choices: investigate (non-xenophobe) or salvage start the project leading to 4058; destroy (non-xenophile) leads to 4055; leaving them (non-xenophobe) keeps the statues with a planet modifier and deposit, ending the story.

notes.zh: 前两个回应只显示回复（is_dialog_only）；接受保护 → 4062 获得哨兵部队；宣称土地 → 4060，可再选择接受或与哨兵开战。
notes.en: The first two answers only show replies (is_dialog_only); accepting protection → 4062 (Sentinel armies join us); claiming the land → 4060, where one can still accept or fight.

label.en: Peace: the Sentinels guard the planet

note.en: The empire gains the Evermore modifier.

note.zh: 按选择得到科研或娱乐修正。
note.en: A science or joy modifier depending on the choice.

scope.zh: 整条故事：4030 分派、遗址三阶段、四种处置、项目结果、战斗与解放（on_action 回调）、地下墓穴两种结果与后续项目、失踪考古学家支线；中英文正文已读。
scope.en: Whole story: the 4030 dispatcher, the three site stages, four ways to deal with the statues, project results, battle and liberation (on_action callbacks), the two tomb results and follow-up projects, the missing-archaeologist side branch; both languages read.

uncertain: Battle outcomes depend on real ground combat; the bridges show the possible callbacks, not probabilities.
